_: Every attachment that moves a stat the game SCALES rather than adds, with the
figure its card showed on each weapon it has been read on, and the multiplier
those figures imply.
WHAT THE SITE USES, IN THIS ORDER
1. `read` for that weapon, when there is one. A figure the game showed is
not improved by being recomputed, and it is what the page prints.
2. `multiplier`, for a weapon with no reading -- an extrapolation, and the
only way one entry can serve a gun nobody has checked it on.
3. nothing. A contested part has no multiplier, so weapons without a
reading simply do not get that line rather than getting a wrong one.
Which means a new weapon can only ever ADD truth here. If its card disagrees
with the multiplier, `basis` goes to contested, the multiplier is dropped,
and every weapon falls back to the figure its own card showed -- no page
stops being right because a gun was added.
BASIS, and it is about this attachment alone -- never about another one that
happens to behave similarly:
proven     read on two or more DIFFERENT bases and one multiplier fits all
assumed    read on one base only. A delta and a multiplier are the same
claim there and differ everywhere else; the reading cannot pick
between them, so the multiplier is a guess about other weapons
contested  read on two or more bases and no multiplier fits them
`read` is written by hand or by `python tools/scaled.py add`. `basis` and
`multiplier` are derived from it and rewritten by that tool; do not edit
them. `python tools/scaled.py check` fails if they have gone stale.
